releaseNotes: Monthly Tour Plan Entry Removal: Allowed both Admin (Web Dashboard) and Medical Representatives (Mobile App) to remove/delete punched Monthly TP entries with instant sync
Fixed White Screen on Submitted Task Page: Added robust Error Boundary and guarded JSON parsing for task orders, dates, and tour plan entries
Persistent Data Retention: Delivery details, assigned tasks, completion status, and Tour Plans are permanently retained across APK updates and server reconnects
Cloud PostgreSQL Sync: Direct real-time synchronization of monthly tour plans and orders to Supabase cloud storage
In-Place Update Support: Automated release signing guarantees seamless in-place APK installation without uninstalling or wiping device data
